title: Generic Week Cache Guard: stale cross-course kernels stop shipping

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.82 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow compiler/cache/source-truth patch; focused regression plus normal local gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on a fresh deployed v0.15.81 Project Management ZIP/log audit. A fresh v0.15.82 package audit is required after deploy to verify the repair against provider output.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: The release is grounded in a fresh deployed v0.15.81 Project Management ZIP/log audit whose exported report and local regrade reached 97/A with generic Week labels, stale off-topic visual-arts content, metadata-only source proof, and texture repetition still below target.
Course-map readiness now treats Week N lesson titles, topics, and weak weekly cells as generic placeholders that require repair before completion.
Lesson-kernel cache reads and writes now reject lessons whose only identity is generic numbered wording or too weak to be course-specific.
Source-finder fallbacks with only metadata-only or review-only evidence export as source review rows and SOURCE_REPORT notes rather than trusted sourceLedger bibliography proof.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh v0.15.82 EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit to verify provider output, export, texture, source review handling, and UI caveats end to end.
If QuotaExceededError reproduces in current-run app logs, add bounded local-save pruning or compression before another product-quality release.
